'''''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Aflame''''' is the first story arc in the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'' comic series]] comic series; unlike the following story arcs, it was not published as a miniseries and its issues did not include the "Aflame" subtitle. It occurs in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] in the [[Republic Dark Age]] during the last century of the [[New Sith Wars]] and is largely narrated through the point of view of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]], a knight errant [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who operated in Sith territory. In the ''Aflame'' arc, Kerra survives an ill-fated Jedi mission to [[Chelloa]], where she establishes contact with the [[Chelloan resistance]] leader [[Gorlan Palladane]], a former Jedi. She takes on two rival [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Daiman]] and [[Odion]], while thwarting their schemes towards Chelloa. Kerra discovers her true mission is to save the civilians from Sith rule rather than taking on the Sith themselves. Following a [[Destruction of Chelloa|climatic apocalypse]], Kerra and Gorlan succeed in evacuating Chelloa's population to the safety of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] space.

''Aflame'' was first released on [[October 13]], [[2010]] and ran through to [[February 16]], [[2011]]. It consisted of five issues and its script was developed by [[John Jackson Miller]]. ''Aflame'' was released as a [[Star Wars: Knight Errant Volume 1: Aflame|trade paperback comic]] by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[July 13]], [[2011]].
